purpose: BodyHands real annotations as the main body, plus high-precision table-tennis pseudo-positives and hard negatives, to raise hand Precision without losing Recall.
leak_policy: BNDSTT_MANUAL_GT_V1 is test-only. Its five source sessions are removed entirely from every mining/labelling/fine-tune pool, not just the 41 annotated frames.

rules_frozen_before_gt.wrist_gate: inside bbox expanded by 0.6*max_side, or centre distance <= 1.2*diagonal
rules_frozen_before_gt.temporal: matched in at least one of the previous two frames (IoU>=0.30 or centre distance <= 0.6*diagonal)

pseudo_positive.bbox_provenance: YOLO hand detector only; wrists never create a box

hard_negative.label_form: image with an empty YOLO label file

composition.val_source: BodyHands val only - checkpoint selection never touches BNDSTT GT

results_bndstt_manual_gt_v1.note: single evaluation, conf 0.25, 41 images / 54 hand GT

v3_temporal.why: only 4 of 36 adjacent GT frame pairs are consecutive (gap==1); the rest are 4-6 frames apart, so a temporal filter cannot be fairly measured here

temporal_helper.status: delivered as an optional B-side helper; the C DetectionResult contract is unchanged
temporal_helper.verdict: not effective as a false-positive reduction mechanism

deployment.cpp_parity: PASS (66 vs 66 boxes, max coordinate difference 0.000893 px)

known_issue_fixed: The previous hand_domain_v3 directory was reused and left 6416 old copy-paste images behind, inflating train to 13197. The builder now wipes the output directory before every build.
